In master branch, I get:
```
./build/debug-gcc-dynamic-ninja/bin/yb-admin list_tablets  demo_2
Error running list_tablets: Invalid argument (yb/tools/yb-admin_client.cc:356): Namespace 'demo_2' of type 'ycql' not found
```
@tedyu Please create keyspace(demo_2) and try the same command
I get the error shown in description if keyspace is created first.

This command works (keyspace k, table n):
```
./build/debug-gcc-dynamic-ninja/bin/yb-admin list_tablets ycql.k n
Tablet-UUID                      	Range                                                    	Leader-IP       	Leader-UUID
fd799ec49a7748bc9b18a4ceebad2e3f 	partition_key_start: "" partition_key_end: "\177\377"    	127.0.0.1:9100  	8fbcbf2e8ae940d9b8234be79d528e29
b26013b6b17d4def82525899fbc30ea0 	partition_key_start: "\177\377" partition_key_end: ""    	127.0.0.1:9100  	8fbcbf2e8ae940d9b8234be79d528e29
```

By default, command takes YCQL type, so it is required to specify the type as well
if user tries with
`bin/yb-admin --master_addresses <master_ips> list_tablets test1`

It gives
`Error running list_tablets: Invalid argument (yb/tools/yb-admin_client.cc:363): Namespace 'test1' of type 'ycql' not found`

cmd should be 
`bin/yb-admin --master_addresses <master_ips> list_tablets type.dbname table/index name`

mentioning **type** in https://docs.yugabyte.com/latest/admin/yb-admin/#list-tablets helps to the end user.

And 
`6. list_tablets <table> [max_tablets] (default 10, set 0 for max) [JSON]`
here it is not taking 10 as default, it lists all tablets

issue.body:
Jira Link: [DB-3755](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-3755)
### Description

When we invoke `yb-admin` without any args, a comprehensive help message is displayed:
```
$ ./build/debug-clang-dynamic-ninja/bin/yb-admin 

yb-admin: ./build/debug-clang-dynamic-ninja/bin/yb-admin [-master_addresses server1:port,server2:port,server3:port,...]  [-timeout_ms <millisec>] [-certs_dir_name <dir_name>] <operation>
<operation> must be one of:
 1. change_config <tablet_id> <ADD_SERVER|REMOVE_SERVER> <peer_uuid> [PRE_VOTER|PRE_OBSERVER]
 2. list_tablet_servers <tablet_id>
 3. backfill_indexes_for_table <table>
 4. list_tables [include_db_type] [include_table_id] [include_table_type]
 5. list_tables_with_db_types
 6. list_tablets <keyspace_type>.<keyspace_name> (keyspace_type is ysql or ycql) <table> [<max_tablets>] (default 10, set 0 for max) [JSON] [include_followers]
 7. modify_table_placement_info <table> <placement_info> <replication_factor> [<placement_uuid>]
 8. modify_placement_info <placement_info> <replication_factor> [<placement_uuid>]
 9. clear_placement_info
 10. add_read_replica_placement_info <placement_info> <replication_factor> [<placement_uuid>]
 11. modify_read_replica_placement_info <placement_info> <replication_factor> [<placement_uuid>]
 12. delete_read_replica_placement_info
 13. delete_namespace <namespace>
 14. delete_namespace_by_id <namespace_id>
 15. delete_table <table>
...

<namespace>:
  [(ycql|ysql).]<namespace_name> (default ycql.)
<table>:
  <namespace> <table_name> | tableid.<table_id>
<index>:
  <namespace> <index_name> | tableid.<index_id>
```
Notice that at the bottom of this help message we display definitions of expressions like `<namespace>` and `<table>`. For example, `<table>` is defined as `<namespace> <table_name> | tableid.<table_id>`. 
We also display hints for each individual command like `15. delete_table <table>`. When a user sees this hint, he/she is able to refer to the definitions at the bottom and realize that `<table>` is either a namespace-table name pair or a table id.

However, when we invoke `yb-admin` with a command, those definitions are not displayed. Only the definition of the individual command is displayed. For example, if we invoke the `delete_table` command:

```
 $ ./build/debug-clang-dynamic-ninja/bin/yb-admin delete_table abc        
Error running delete_table: Invalid argument (yb/tools/yb-admin_client.cc:359): Namespace 'abc' of type 'ycql' not found
Usage: ./build/debug-clang-dynamic-ninja/bin/yb-admin delete_table  <table>
```
As a user, when I see this error message, I might be confused, because the definition of `<table>` is not clear. I might think that `<table>` refers to a table name. Other cases include `list_tablets`: https://github.com/yugabyte/yugabyte-db/issues/10432.

We should display those definitions when a user invokes individual commands as well. We should also update the [doc page ](https://docs.yugabyte.com/preview/admin/yb-admin/#list-tablets) to include these definitions.

body: Resolved issues regarding default 10 tablets, missing table name error message, and add keyspace to the error message. Also added a follow up issue: https://github.com/yugabyte/yugabyte-db/issues/14326.
